name: Path of Love: train ojisan thirst simulator
source:
Path of Love is a short Warden Ingo/PLA MC fanmade VN made in Ren'py with two different stories. You can play as either Rei or Akari.

Story 1: Path of Love: Irida wants you to find a way to make her warden smile. Explore Jubilife Village, talk to NPCs for hints, and try not to end up on the (metaphorical) Path of Solitude...

Story 2: Cave Story: The trip through Wayward Cave goes a little off-track.
